import base64,hashlib,io,json,os,shutil,subprocess,sys,tarfile,time
from pathlib import Path

def digest(path):
 h=hashlib.sha256()
 with Path(path).open('rb') as f:
  for b in iter(lambda:f.read(16*1024*1024),b''):h.update(b)
 return h.hexdigest()
raw=base64.b64decode('');assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()=='8bc93da4ee61b95c9af55321a88c58d22e32edd55e056ac07dffac9ddcd73892'
control=Path('/datasets/nuscenes-full/hugsim/iter139_control_20261009');output=Path('/datasets/nuscenes-full/hugsim/outputs/iter139-20261009')
assert not control.exists() and not output.exists()
control.mkdir();packet=control/'packet';packet.mkdir()
with tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(raw)) as archive:
 for m in archive.getmembers():
  p=Path(m.name);assert not p.is_absolute() and '..' not in p.parts and (m.isfile() or m.isdir())
 archive.extractall(packet)
sys.path.insert(0,str(packet))
old=packet/'experiments/iter136_hugsim_recoverability_canary';prior=packet/'experiments/iter138_numerical_live_replay';new=packet/'experiments/iter139_finite_pulse_recoverability'
manifest=json.loads((prior/'proof/runtime_manifest.json').read_text());start=time.monotonic()
for name,expected in manifest['files'].items():
 p=Path(name);assert p.is_file() and not p.is_symlink() and digest(p)==expected,name
report=dict(source_commit='887bac942e24b8189459210b591ab42538745314',packet_sha256='8bc93da4ee61b95c9af55321a88c58d22e32edd55e056ac07dffac9ddcd73892',prior_bound_files=len(manifest['files']),prior_validation_seconds=time.monotonic()-start)
from experiments.iter139_finite_pulse_recoverability.instrument import instrument
(control/'iter139_closed_loop.py').write_bytes(instrument((old/'proof/source/HUGSIM/closed_loop.py.txt').read_bytes()))
for name in ['run_episode.py','live_trace.py']:shutil.copyfile(new/name,control/name)
client=(old/'proof/runtime_v2/e2e.sh.txt').read_text().replace('i136','i139').replace('iter136','iter139').replace('I136','I139')
(control/'e2e.sh').write_text(client);(control/'e2e.sh').chmod(0o755)
base=(old/'proof/runtime_v2/nuscenes_base.yaml.txt').read_text().replace('iter136_control_20261009_v2','iter139_control_20261009');(control/'nuscenes_base.yaml').write_text(base)
identity=json.loads((old/'proof/runtime_v2/identity.json.txt').read_text());identity['driver_sha256']=digest(control/'iter139_closed_loop.py')
(control/'identity.json').write_text(json.dumps(identity,sort_keys=True,indent=2)+'\n')
manifest.update(schema='sentinel.iter139.runtime_binding.v1',iteration=139,source_commit='887bac942e24b8189459210b591ab42538745314',parent_manifest_sha256=digest(prior/'proof/runtime_manifest.json'),deadline_epoch=1791565110.7621582,scope='two references then six finite pulse interventions conditional on all validation gates',pre_initialization_failed_launches=0)
for p in control.rglob('*'):
 if p.is_file() and '__pycache__' not in p.parts:manifest['files'][str(p)]=digest(p)
(control/'runtime_manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(manifest,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n')
(control/'validations').mkdir();output.mkdir()
report.update(manifest=manifest,manifest_sha256=digest(control/'runtime_manifest.json'),generated_driver_sha256=identity['driver_sha256'])
print(json.dumps(report,indent=2))
